The Breaking Point#095.src: DIVERTING MINER MECHS TO HALT INTRUDER.
The Breaking Point#095.dst: ENVIANDO MECHS MINEIROS CONTRA O INTRUSO.
The Breaking Point#095.speaker: The Mother Drill

The Breaking Point#096.src: Return to the hot air balloon at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] with the Magmaflux Capacitor.
The Breaking Point#096.dst: Volte ao balão de ar quente em [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] com o Capacitor Magmaflux.

The Breaking Point#097.src: Good to see you again, {u}. Good luck with the colossus. And Rhay... come home as soon as you can.
The Breaking Point#097.dst: Bom te ver de novo, {u}. Boa sorte com o Colosso. E Rhay... volte pra casa assim que puder.
The Breaking Point#097.speaker: Maxie

The Breaking Point#099.src: Return to General Elix with the Corkian Stabiliser
The Breaking Point#099.dst: Leve o Estabilizador Corkian ao General Elix

The Breaking Point#100.src: Well... that went better than expected, really. I still can't believe you didn't tell me you already knew Maxie.
The Breaking Point#100.dst: Bem... foi melhor do que o esperado, na verdade. Ainda não acredito que não me contou que já conhecia o Maxie.
The Breaking Point#100.speaker: Rhay

The Breaking Point#101.src: Oh, wow. It looks like they've managed to fix up the machine pretty well, all things considered. Just this part left to get it running again...
The Breaking Point#101.dst: Nossa. Parece que conseguiram consertar bem a máquina, considerando tudo. Só falta esta peça para ela voltar a funcionar...
The Breaking Point#101.speaker: Rhay

The Breaking Point#102.src: Hmph. Rhay, there you are. Seeing as you've returned, I gather everything went smoothly at Corkus?
The Breaking Point#102.dst: Hunf. Rhay, aí está você. Já que voltou, imagino que tudo correu bem em Corkus?
The Breaking Point#102.speaker: General Elix

The Breaking Point#103.src: Smoothly enough, General! We have what we need to repair the control panel. We'll be able to get the stabilizer running again!
The Breaking Point#103.dst: Bem o bastante, General! Temos o necessário para consertar o painel de controle. Vamos conseguir religar o estabilizador!
The Breaking Point#103.speaker: Rhay

The Breaking Point#104.src: Well?! What are you waiting for? Finish the repairs, we can't afford to lose any time with this damned Colossus looming over us.
The Breaking Point#104.dst: E então?! O que estão esperando? Terminem os reparos, não podemos perder tempo com esse maldito Colosso pairando sobre nós.
The Breaking Point#104.speaker: General Elix

The Breaking Point#105.src: Yes, sir! Alright. {u}, just slot the capacitor in right... there. I'll make sure it runs smoothly.
The Breaking Point#105.dst: Sim, senhor! Certo. {u}, é só encaixar o capacitor bem... ali. Eu garanto que vai funcionar direito.
The Breaking Point#105.speaker: Rhay

The Breaking Point#106.src: There we are. Now, let's get this thing running again! Walder, keep an eye on stability! And... Rhay. You're confident this will work?
The Breaking Point#106.dst: Pronto. Agora, vamos religar essa coisa! Walder, fique de olho na estabilidade! E... Rhay. Você tem certeza de que isso vai funcionar?
The Breaking Point#106.speaker: General Elix

The Breaking Point#107.src: I-I'm sure. This is our last chance. We have to hold out hope that the stabilizer will hold.
The Breaking Point#107.dst: T-tenho certeza. É nossa última chance. Temos que acreditar que o estabilizador vai aguentar.
The Breaking Point#107.speaker: Rhay

The Breaking Point#108.src: Alright, alright... It's now or never... Hold, stabilizer, hold!
The Breaking Point#108.dst: Certo, certo... Agora ou nunca... Aguente, estabilizador, aguente!
The Breaking Point#108.speaker: Rhay

The Breaking Point#109.src: ... Oh. That's... that's it, then. It's over. We failed.
The Breaking Point#109.dst: ... Ah. Então é... é isso. Acabou. Fracassamos.
The Breaking Point#109.speaker: Rhay

The Breaking Point#110.src: I... am sorry, Rhay. I had... hoped it would work. In truth... I do not have... a plan... either.
The Breaking Point#110.dst: Eu... lamento, Rhay. Eu... esperava que funcionasse. Na verdade... também não tenho... um plano.
The Breaking Point#110.speaker: Ineos

The Breaking Point#111.src: The Elders... would have known... what to do... But they are... long gone. Nothing but... ruins remain.
The Breaking Point#111.dst: Os Anciões... saberiam... o que fazer... Mas eles se foram... há muito. Nada além de... ruínas restou.
The Breaking Point#111.speaker: Ineos

The Breaking Point#112.src: The Elders... They were... the greatest... of doguns. As old... as the oldest stones... and as wise... as the earth itself...
The Breaking Point#112.dst: Os Anciões... Eram... os maiores... dos Doguns. Velhos... como as pedras mais antigas... e sábios... como a própria terra...
The Breaking Point#112.speaker: Ineos

The Breaking Point#113.src: They were capable... of magic... beyond what any... of us could achieve. They alone... could calm our... Protector.
The Breaking Point#113.dst: Eram capazes... de magia... além do que qualquer... um de nós alcança. Só eles... acalmavam nosso... Protetor.
The Breaking Point#113.speaker: Ineos

The Breaking Point#114.dst: O que houve com os Anciões?

The Breaking Point#115.src: They were... sealed away. Frozen in... the deepest... of ice. When the dwarves... slew Garaheth... the Elders... fell with him.
The Breaking Point#115.dst: Foram... selados. Congelados no... gelo mais... profundo. Quando os anões... mataram Garaheth... os Anciões... caíram com ele.
The Breaking Point#115.speaker: Ineos

The Breaking Point#116.src: Such atrocities... The war... My people... But it is not... to dwell on, now. There are... more important... things at hand.
The Breaking Point#116.dst: Tantas atrocidades... A guerra... Meu povo... Mas não é hora... de remoer isso. Há coisas... mais importantes... agora.
The Breaking Point#116.speaker: Ineos

The Breaking Point#117.src: But the war is over. The dwa
The Breaking Point#117.dst: Mas a guerra acabou. Os anõ

The Breaking Point#118.src: I... I did not... know of this. My people... are free? How long... has it been... since I have seen... my home?
The Breaking Point#118.dst: Eu... eu não... sabia disso. Meu povo... está livre? Quanto tempo... faz... desde que vi... meu lar?
The Breaking Point#118.speaker: Ineos

The Breaking Point#119.src: You... Adventurer. We must... speak to my people. Our chieftain... will know... how we may free... the Elders.
The Breaking Point#119.dst: Você... Aventureiro. Precisamos... falar com meu povo. Nosso cacique... saberá... como libertar... os Anciões.
The Breaking Point#119.speaker: Ineos

The Breaking Point#120.src: If there's a chance... We have to take it. Ineos, {u}, take the balloon. We'll do what we can here. Now, go! There's no time to waste!
The Breaking Point#120.dst: Se há uma chance... Temos que agarrá-la. Ineos, {u}, peguem o balão. Faremos o que pudermos aqui. Agora, vão! Não há tempo a perder!
The Breaking Point#120.speaker: General Elix

The Breaking Point#121.src: It looks like Ozoth's body is trying to prevent you from getting the Everflame!
The Breaking Point#121.dst: Parece que o corpo de Ozoth está tentando impedir que você pegue a Chama Eterna!

The Breaking Point#122.src: Meet Ineos and Rhay at the Hot Air Balloon at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
The Breaking Point#122.dst: Encontre Ineos e Rhay no balão de ar quente em [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Breaking Point#123.src: I have never... seen the Heights... from above. I wonder... if their glow... holds the same strength... it does from below...
The Breaking Point#123.dst: Nunca... vi as Heights... de cima. Será... que o brilho delas... tem a mesma força... que vista de baixo...
The Breaking Point#123.speaker: Ineos

The Breaking Point#124.src: I only hope... the Elders... are not gone... for good. We greatly need... their wisdom.
The Breaking Point#124.dst: Espero... que os Anciões... não tenham ido... de vez. Precisamos... da sabedoria deles.
The Breaking Point#124.speaker: Ineos

The Breaking Point#125.src: Ah... I believe us... to be landing...
The Breaking Point#125.speaker: Ineos

The Breaking Point#126.src: Travel to {p} with Ineos via the Hot Air Balloon at [{~}, {~}, -{~}]
The Breaking Point#126.dst: Viaje até {p} com Ineos pelo balão de ar quente em [{~}, {~}, -{~}]

The Breaking Point#127.src: {u}... Hello. What a... strange sight... to see you landing... at our village... in such a contraption...
The Breaking Point#127.dst: {u}... Olá. Que... cena estranha... ver você pousando... em nossa aldeia... numa engenhoca dessas...
The Breaking Point#127.speaker: Korzim

The Breaking Point#128.src: And... is that... Ineos? We thought... the dwarves... had turned you to rubble...
The Breaking Point#128.dst: E... aquele é... Ineos? Achamos... que os anões... te reduziram a escombros...
The Breaking Point#128.speaker: Korzim

The Breaking Point#129.src: I escaped... It is a long... story, Korzim. We do not... have time. Where is... your father?
The Breaking Point#129.dst: Eu escapei... É uma longa... história, Korzim. Não temos... tempo. Onde está... seu pai?
The Breaking Point#129.speaker: Ineos

The Breaking Point#130.src: He is... below. They are... freeing the frozen... in New Taloka. Why do you... wish to speak... with him?
The Breaking Point#130.dst: Está... lá embaixo. Estão... libertando os congelados... em New Taloka. Por que... quer falar... com ele?
The Breaking Point#130.speaker: Korzim

The Breaking Point#131.src: The Protector... is angered. We must find... the Elders. They will know... how to calm it.
The Breaking Point#131.dst: O Protetor... está irado. Precisamos achar... os Anciões. Eles saberão... como acalmá-lo.
The Breaking Point#131.speaker: Ineos

The Breaking Point#132.src: The... Protector... I understand. I will... bring you two... to him. Sidio... Raetin... I leave you two... in charge.
The Breaking Point#132.dst: O... Protetor... Entendo. Vou... levar vocês dois... até ele. Sidio... Raetin... deixo vocês dois... no comando.
The Breaking Point#132.speaker: Korzim

The Breaking Point#133.src: Now, let us... travel. Through flame... and through stone...
The Breaking Point#133.dst: Agora... viajemos. Pela chama... e pela pedra...
The Breaking Point#133.speaker: Korzim

The Breaking Point#134.src: Speak to {p}'s King and the Dogun Chieftain at New Taloka at [{~}, {~}, -{~}]
The Breaking Point#134.dst: Fale com o rei de {p} e com o cacique Dogun em New Taloka, em [{~}, {~}, -{~}]

The Breaking Point#135.src: We are... here. Taloka was... one of the first to fall... in the war. We have been... working with the dwarves... to restore it.
The Breaking Point#135.dst: Chegamos... aqui. Taloka foi... uma das primeiras a cair... na guerra. Temos... trabalhado com os anões... para restaurá-la.
The Breaking Point#135.speaker: Korzim

The Breaking Point#139.src: Very well. Begin on three. One... Two... Three!
The Breaking Point#139.dst: Muito bem. Comecem no três. Um... Dois... Três!
The Breaking Point#139.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#140.src: Beginning reheating cycle! Stand back from the subject.
The Breaking Point#140.dst: Iniciando ciclo de reaquecimento! Afastem-se do sujeito.
The Breaking Point#140.speaker: Dwarven Technician

The Breaking Point#141.src: ... Where... am... I? How long... has it... been...?
The Breaking Point#141.speaker: Unsealed Dogun

The Breaking Point#142.src: ...Dwarf... You... you froze me... I will... I will...!
The Breaking Point#142.dst: ...Anão... Você... me congelou... Eu vou... Eu vou...!
The Breaking Point#142.speaker: Unsealed Dogun

The Breaking Point#143.src: Calm yourself... Delg. Our war... has ended. We are... freed. You have been... freed.
The Breaking Point#143.dst: Acalme-se... Delg. Nossa guerra... terminou. Estamos... livres. Você foi... libertado.
The Breaking Point#143.speaker: Chieftain Paku

The Breaking Point#144.src: ... Freedom? Hundreds... of years... of war... And we are... free?
The Breaking Point#144.dst: ... Liberdade? Séculos... de guerra... E estamos... livres?
The Breaking Point#144.speaker: Dogun Delg

The Breaking Point#145.src: Yes. We are free... to roam our home... once more. Edac... Escort Delg... and help him re-adjust... to the heights.
The Breaking Point#145.dst: Sim. Livres... para percorrer nosso lar... de novo. Edac... Leve Delg... e ajude-o a se readaptar... às Heights.
The Breaking Point#145.speaker: Chieftain Paku

The Breaking Point#146.src: Ah, {u}! It's good to see you again. We haven't seen you around here since... since the end of it.
The Breaking Point#146.dst: Ah, {u}! Que bom te ver de novo. Não te vemos por aqui desde... desde o fim de tudo.
The Breaking Point#146.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#147.src: Yes. We have been... hard at work... these past weeks. Taloka will soon... stand once more. And many... of our sealed bretheren... have been returned to life.
The Breaking Point#147.dst: Sim. Temos... trabalhado duro... nestas últimas semanas. Taloka logo... voltará a se erguer. E muitos... dos nossos irmãos selados... voltaram à vida.
The Breaking Point#147.speaker: Chieftain Paku

The Breaking Point#148.src: Yes. We have been... hard at work... these past weeks. Taloka will soon... stand once more. And many... of our sealed brethren... have been returned to life.
The Breaking Point#148.dst: Sim. Temos... trabalhado duro... nestas últimas semanas. Taloka logo... voltará a se erguer. E muitos... dos nossos irmãos selados... voltaram à vida.
The Breaking Point#148.speaker: Chieftain Paku

The Breaking Point#150.src: You use the grappling hook to swing back to the King in a dazzling feat of trapeze consisting of mid-air flips and acrobatic flourishes.
The Breaking Point#150.dst: Você usa o gancho para voltar até o rei num deslumbrante número de trapézio, com piruetas no ar e floreios acrobáticos.

The Breaking Point#151.src: Ah, but we can talk more about that later. Tell me, what brings you here today? Is there something you need from us?
The Breaking Point#151.dst: Ah, mas podemos falar disso depois. Diga, o que te traz aqui hoje? Precisa de algo de nós?
The Breaking Point#151.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#152.src: The situtation... is dire. The Great Protector... has been left alone... for far too long. We need... the wisdom... of our Elders. Do you know... where they are sealed?
The Breaking Point#152.dst: A situação... é grave. O Grande Protetor... foi deixado sozinho... por tempo demais. Precisamos... da sabedoria... dos nossos Anciões. Sabe... onde estão selados?
The Breaking Point#152.speaker: Ineos

The Breaking Point#153.src: The situation... is dire. The Great Protector... has been left alone... for far too long. We need... the wisdom... of our Elders. Do you know... where they are sealed?
The Breaking Point#153.dst: A situação... é grave. O Grande Protetor... foi deixado sozinho... por tempo demais. Precisamos... da sabedoria... dos nossos Anciões. Sabe... onde estão selados?
The Breaking Point#153.speaker: Ineos

The Breaking Point#154.src: The Elders?! Yes, we know where they are sealed. However, retrieving them is no simple task. It would take us years to break past the defenses, and we have countless other doguns to release first.
The Breaking Point#154.dst: Os Anciões?! Sim, sabemos onde estão selados. Mas resgatá-los não é tarefa simples. Levaríamos anos para romper as defesas, e temos incontáveis outros Doguns para libertar antes.
The Breaking Point#154.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#156.src: Ineos... I want our Elders free... as much as you do. But our Protector... has stood firm... for hundreds of years. It can stand... for another-
The Breaking Point#156.dst: Ineos... quero nossos Anciões livres... tanto quanto você. Mas nosso Protetor... se mantém firme... há centenas de anos. Pode aguentar... mais um-
The Breaking Point#156.speaker: Chieftain Paku

The Breaking Point#157.src: No... Has it truly... fallen this far..?
The Breaking Point#157.dst: Não... Será que... chegou a esse ponto..?
The Breaking Point#157.speaker: Chieftain Paku

The Breaking Point#158.src: ... That was your Protector? How powerful is it, if it can reach this far?
The Breaking Point#158.dst: ... Aquilo era seu Protetor? Quão forte ele é, se chega tão longe?
The Breaking Point#158.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#159.src: If the Protector... could shake even the Heights... It could destroy... half of this province.
The Breaking Point#159.dst: Se o Protetor... pode sacudir até as Heights... Poderia destruir... metade desta província.
The Breaking Point#159.speaker: Korzim

The Breaking Point#160.src: Draani... the Elders must be freed. They alone... would know how to calm it.
The Breaking Point#160.dst: Draani... os Anciões precisam ser libertados. Só eles... saberiam acalmá-lo.
The Breaking Point#160.speaker: Chieftain Paku

The Breaking Point#161.src: Yes... I understand. Very well. {u}, I will take you to the Elders' vault. I hold the keys to open the way forward. Paku, gather your people. See if anyone has alternative solutions.
The Breaking Point#161.dst: Sim... entendo. Muito bem. {u}, vou te levar ao cofre dos Anciões. Tenho as chaves que abrem o caminho. Paku, reúna seu povo. Veja se alguém tem soluções alternativas.
The Breaking Point#161.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#162.src: We will... search for one. I cannot... promise that one exists.
The Breaking Point#162.dst: Vamos... procurar uma. Não posso... prometer que exista.
The Breaking Point#162.speaker: Chieftain Paku

The Breaking Point#163.src: {u}, let us go. It sounds as if we have very little time to waste.
The Breaking Point#163.dst: {u}, vamos. Parece que temos muito pouco tempo a perder.
The Breaking Point#163.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#164.src: I will make preparations, and meet you at the Vault of Ice.
The Breaking Point#164.dst: Vou fazer os preparativos e te encontro no Cofre de Gelo.
The Breaking Point#164.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#165.src: Enter the Dogun Vault within the lower Freezing Heights at [{~}, {~}, -{~}]
The Breaking Point#165.dst: Entre no Cofre Dogun nas Freezing Heights inferiores em [{~}, {~}, -{~}]

The Breaking Point#166.src: ... Ahem. This is the entrance, then. One of our most closely guarded secrets... I was hoping not to have to confront this reminder for a while yet...
The Breaking Point#166.dst: ... Aham. Esta é a entrada, então. Um dos nossos segredos mais bem guardados... Eu esperava não ter que encarar esta lembrança tão cedo...
The Breaking Point#166.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#167.src: But it seems we don't have much choice now. I have the keys, let's go inside.
The Breaking Point#167.dst: Mas parece que não temos muita escolha agora. Tenho as chaves, vamos entrar.
The Breaking Point#167.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#168.src: Unlock the Dogun Vault to find the Elders.
The Breaking Point#168.dst: Destranque o Cofre Dogun para encontrar os Anciões.

The Breaking Point#169.src: Rather cold in here, isn't it? A vault carved into a drake's True Ice... I suppose my ancestors hoped to seal these doguns here forever. I'll be glad to disappoint them.
The Breaking Point#169.dst: Bem frio aqui, não? Um cofre esculpido no True Ice de um drake... Meus ancestrais queriam selar esses Doguns aqui para sempre. Será um prazer decepcioná-los.
The Breaking Point#169.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#170.src: Quickly, then, let us proceed to the primary door. I pray the Elders' will be responsive to our situation with the Colossus.
The Breaking Point#170.dst: Rápido, então, vamos até a porta principal. Espero que os Anciões nos ouçam sobre a situação do Colosso.
The Breaking Point#170.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#171.src: In any case... Let me see if I can open this second gate. It should be as simple as...
The Breaking Point#171.dst: Enfim... Vejamos se consigo abrir este segundo portão. Deve ser tão simples quanto...
The Breaking Point#171.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#172.src: Hm. That... didn't work. This magic is old, and I have never took the time to learn it properly... Alright. We have alternatives.
The Breaking Point#172.dst: Hm. Isso... não funcionou. Esta magia é antiga, e nunca tirei tempo para aprendê-la direito... Certo. Temos alternativas.
The Breaking Point#172.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#173.src: If my memory serves correctly, there should be a manual override on the other side of this chasm.
The Breaking Point#173.dst: Se a memória não me falha, deve haver um acionamento manual do outro lado deste abismo.
The Breaking Point#173.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#174.src: Hm. That... didn't work. This magic is old, and I never took the time to learn it properly... Alright. We have alternatives.
The Breaking Point#174.dst: Hm. Isso... não funcionou. Esta magia é antiga, e nunca tirei tempo para aprendê-la direito... Certo. Temos alternativas.
The Breaking Point#174.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#175.src: If my memory serves correctly, there should be a manual override on the other end of this chasm.
The Breaking Point#175.dst: Se a memória não me falha, deve haver um acionamento manual na outra ponta deste abismo.
The Breaking Point#175.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#177.src: The issue is that treacherous pool of lava on the way... and I don't think my knees are up to the task of jumping over it all.
The Breaking Point#177.dst: O problema é aquela traiçoeira poça de lava no caminho... e acho que meus joelhos não aguentam pular tudo aquilo.
The Breaking Point#177.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#178.src: I would never usually do this, but these are desperate times. Here, take my Trusty Grappling Hook. It should help you get over to the switch.
The Breaking Point#178.dst: Eu nunca faria isso, mas os tempos são de desespero. Tome, meu fiel Grappling Hook. Deve ajudar você a chegar ao interruptor.
The Breaking Point#178.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#179.src: It has limitations, though. It will only be able to latch onto those blue rocks on the walls - and I'll be taking it back once you're finished, thank you very much!
The Breaking Point#179.dst: Mas tem limites. Só se prende àquelas rochas azuis nas paredes - e vou pegá-lo de volta assim que você terminar, muito obrigado!
The Breaking Point#179.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#180.src: Hey, {u}! Looks like you're doing good so far, but if you get stuck remember you can jump and then grapple mid-air, that might help on some of those trickier platforms!
The Breaking Point#180.dst: Ei, {u}! Parece que está indo bem, mas se travar, lembre que dá para pular e usar o gancho no ar, isso ajuda nas plataformas mais difíceis!
The Breaking Point#180.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#181.src: Looks like that unlocked it, {u}! Get yourself back over here and I'll open the door.
The Breaking Point#181.dst: Parece que isso destravou, {u}! Volte para cá e eu abro a porta.
The Breaking Point#181.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#182.src: There we are! Excellent work. You used that hook like a true expert! Ah, reminds me of the time-...
The Breaking Point#182.dst: Aí está! Excelente. Usou o gancho como um verdadeiro especialista! Ah, me lembra da vez que-...
The Breaking Point#182.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#183.src: ...Ahem. Excellent work, indeed. With the override activated, I should be able to do the rest of the work to open the gate.
The Breaking Point#183.dst: ...Aham. Excelente trabalho, de fato. Com o acionamento ativado, devo conseguir fazer o resto para abrir o portão.
The Breaking Point#183.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#184.src: First, though, I'll be having that grappling hook back! Think of what could happen if you had free reign of that all over.
The Breaking Point#184.dst: Mas antes, quero meu gancho de volta! Imagine o que aconteceria se você o usasse à vontade por aí.
The Breaking Point#184.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#185.src: And so... I believe we have gone as far as we can.
The Breaking Point#185.dst: E assim... acho que fomos o mais longe possível.
The Breaking Point#185.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#186.src: This is True Ice, {u}. It has scarred this part of the Heights for centuries, ever since it was created by an ice dragon in my ancestors' conquest.
The Breaking Point#186.dst: Isto é True Ice, {u}. Marca esta parte das Heights há séculos, desde que um dragão de gelo o criou na conquista dos meus ancestrais.
The Breaking Point#186.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#187.src: When were the elders first i

The Breaking Point#188.src: It cannot be melted or burned through by any means. It is why this location was chosen for their tomb. I'm afraid there is nothing more we can do.
The Breaking Point#188.dst: Não há como derretê-lo nem queimá-lo. Por isso este lugar foi escolhido para a tumba deles. Receio que não possamos fazer mais nada.
The Breaking Point#188.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#189.src: At the end of the war, I imagine.
The Breaking Point#189.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#190.src: As the final dogun settlements fell, and as Garaheth was slain for the first time, my ancestors must have sealed them deep in this ice.
The Breaking Point#190.dst: Quando caíram os últimos povoados Dogun e Garaheth foi morto pela primeira vez, meus ancestrais devem tê-los selado no fundo do gelo.
The Breaking Point#190.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#191.src: The... actions of the Dwarves after winning the war are well documented. I would not be surprised if our accounts describe this imprisonment as a great victory.
The Breaking Point#191.dst: Os... atos dos anões após vencer a guerra estão bem documentados. Não me surpreenderia se nossos registros chamassem esta prisão de grande vitória.
The Breaking Point#191.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#193.src: The Dwarves, of course. Who else?
The Breaking Point#193.dst: Os anões, é claro. Quem mais?
The Breaking Point#193.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#194.src: I believe it was General Algard of the Dwarven army who ordered the Elders' imprisonments
The Breaking Point#194.dst: Creio que foi o General Algard, do exército anão, quem mandou prender os Anciões
The Breaking Point#194.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#195.src: He was lauded as a hero, naturally. Now... now we must reap the consequences of such a decision.
The Breaking Point#195.dst: Foi aclamado como herói, claro. Agora... agora devemos colher as consequências dessa decisão.
The Breaking Point#195.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#196.src: True Ice is a material which cannot be melted or burned through by any means. Not even dogun magic has been able to make a dent.
The Breaking Point#196.dst: True Ice é um material que não pode ser derretido nem queimado de forma alguma. Nem a magia Dogun conseguiu arranhá-lo.
The Breaking Point#196.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#197.src: ... I imagine this is why this location was chosen to hold the elders. A prison from which they would never be able to escape.
The Breaking Point#197.dst: ... Imagino que por isso este lugar foi escolhido para prender os anciões. Uma prisão da qual jamais poderiam escapar.
The Breaking Point#197.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#198.src: It is known for it to form naturally under extreme conditions... But the ice here is nowhere near natural.
The Breaking Point#198.dst: Sabe-se que ele se forma naturalmente em condições extremas... Mas este gelo não tem nada de natural.
The Breaking Point#198.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#199.src: It was formed by an Ice Drake's Breath partway through the war- and, well, as you can see, it has remained here ever since.
The Breaking Point#199.dst: Foi formado pelo sopro de um Ice Drake no meio da guerra- e, bem, como você vê, continua aqui desde então.
The Breaking Point#199.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#200.src: Just another remnant of our past mistakes, I suppose...
The Breaking Point#200.dst: Mais um resquício dos nossos erros passados, suponho...
The Breaking Point#200.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#201.src: Ahem. In any case- as I said, True Ice is impossible to break through, even with the most scorching flames.
The Breaking Point#201.dst: Aham. Enfim- como eu disse, é impossível atravessar o True Ice, mesmo com as chamas mais ardentes.
The Breaking Point#201.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#202.src: If an Ice Drake formed this
The Breaking Point#202.dst: Se um Ice Drake formou isto

The Breaking Point#203.src: I... I suppose that a dragon's breath might be able to melt it. That logic does make sense.
The Breaking Point#203.dst: Eu... suponho que o sopro de um dragão poderia derretê-lo. A lógica faz sentido.
The Breaking Point#203.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#204.src: We have little knowledge of what dragons were like, though. As they went extinct, that information became... useless. And so, it was lost.
The Breaking Point#204.dst: Mas sabemos pouco sobre como eram os dragões. Com a extinção, essa informação ficou... inútil. E assim se perdeu.
The Breaking Point#204.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#205.src: If anyone would know more about dragons, it would be the doguns.
The Breaking Point#205.dst: Se alguém sabe mais sobre dragões, são os Doguns.
The Breaking Point#205.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#206.src: But none of that matters. All the dragons are gone, after all. We still have no options.
The Breaking Point#206.dst: Mas nada disso importa. Afinal, os dragões se foram. Continuamos sem opções.
The Breaking Point#206.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#207.src: Why, they died out. As Gavellian civilizations grew in size, the ferocity and size of a dragon was simply too big a threat.
The Breaking Point#207.dst: Ora, foram extintos. Com o crescimento das civilizações de Gavel, a fúria e o porte de um dragão eram ameaça demais.
The Breaking Point#207.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#208.src: Some were hunted. Some died of starvation. Eggs were taken from nests and shattered over boulders for the birds to feed on.
The Breaking Point#208.dst: Alguns foram caçados. Outros morreram de fome. Ovos eram tirados dos ninhos e esmagados nas rochas para os pássaros.
The Breaking Point#208.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#209.src: Now all that are left are dragonlings - echoes of their once-great ancestors, with barely enough flame to singe your armor.
The Breaking Point#209.dst: Agora só restam dragõezinhos - ecos de seus grandiosos ancestrais, com fogo mal suficiente para chamuscar sua armadura.
The Breaking Point#209.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#210.src: Not all of the dragons are g

The Breaking Point#212.src: A living dragon... You've done quite a lot, haven't you? Stopped a war, moved a dragon...
The Breaking Point#212.dst: Um dragão vivo... Você fez muita coisa, hein? Parou uma guerra, mudou um dragão de lugar.
The Breaking Point#212.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#213.src: Well... if there is a living dragon at {p}... Then we still have hope! {u}, we must ask for its help.
The Breaking Point#213.dst: Bem... se há um dragão vivo em {p}... Então ainda há esperança! {u}, precisamos pedir ajuda a ele.
The Breaking Point#213.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#214.src: Let us return to the others. I asked them to wait outside of {p}... perhaps they'll be able to confirm that a dragon's breath would do the job.
The Breaking Point#214.dst: Vamos voltar aos outros. Pedi que esperassem fora de {p}... talvez confirmem que o sopro de um dragão resolveria.
The Breaking Point#214.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#215.src: Indeed. The fire dragons sided with them during the war. I'm sure you've come across the skeleton just outside Freezing Heights?
The Breaking Point#215.dst: De fato. Os dragões de fogo ficaram do lado deles na guerra. Você já deve ter visto o esqueleto logo fora das Freezing Heights?
The Breaking Point#215.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#216.src: Yes, well... the Dwarves needed a counter to the sheer power of a fire dragon in battle, and so they resorted to enslaving dragons and drakes of other elements.
The Breaking Point#216.dst: Sim, bem... os anões precisavam de algo contra o poder de um dragão de fogo em batalha, então recorreram a escravizar dragões e drakes de outros elementos.
The Breaking Point#216.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#217.src: Like the Ice Drake that created this vault, and encased the Elders in the truest of ice.
The Breaking Point#217.dst: Como o Ice Drake que criou este cofre e prendeu os Anciões no mais puro dos gelos.
The Breaking Point#217.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#218.src: ... Well, there was this excellent novel of about one of those creatures from the Shiar, who had to travel to the Heights with this ring he had inherited-
The Breaking Point#218.dst: ... Bem, havia um ótimo romance sobre uma dessas criaturas do Shiar, que precisava viajar até as Heights com um anel que herdou-
The Breaking Point#218.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#219.src: But I confess, these questions seem almost irrelevant. We have a more pressing issue at hand, {u}.
The Breaking Point#219.dst: Mas confesso que essas perguntas parecem quase irrelevantes. Temos um problema mais urgente, {u}.
The Breaking Point#219.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#220.src: This ice is harder than obsidian itself. The crystals which form the material are bonded by ancient magic.
The Breaking Point#220.dst: Este gelo é mais duro que obsidiana. Os cristais que formam o material são unidos por magia antiga.
The Breaking Point#220.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#221.src: Shattering it with such tools isn't an option. Perhaps there is a weapon that could break through, somewhere deep in our armory- after all, this vault had to be carved somehow...
The Breaking Point#221.dst: Quebrá-lo com essas ferramentas não é opção. Talvez haja uma arma capaz disso no fundo do nosso arsenal- afinal, este cofre foi esculpido de algum jeito...
The Breaking Point#221.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#222.src: However, given the circumstances, I don't think we have the time to search for it. Even if we started now, our armory is enormous. It would take weeks to find what we need.
The Breaking Point#222.dst: Mas, dadas as circunstâncias, acho que não temos tempo de procurá-la. Mesmo começando agora, nosso arsenal é enorme. Levaria semanas para achar o que precisamos.
The Breaking Point#222.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#223.src: The lava of the Heights is nothing more than molten rock. Just a remnant of the shaping of these caverns.
The Breaking Point#223.dst: A lava das Heights não passa de rocha derretida. Só um resquício da formação destas cavernas.
The Breaking Point#223.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#224.src: It's not nearly hot enough to melt True Ice. If it could, the Freezing Heights would have faded long ago.
The Breaking Point#224.dst: Nem de longe é quente o bastante para derreter True Ice. Senão, as Freezing Heights já teriam sumido.
The Breaking Point#224.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#225.src: My... uhm... green is nice, I suppose? Though perhaps not very Dwarven...
The Breaking Point#225.dst: Hum... é... o verde é bonito, acho? Embora talvez não seja muito anão...
The Breaking Point#225.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#226.src: Red, then. Or orange! ...Although my bedsheets are the most wonderful shade of navy blue...
The Breaking Point#226.dst: Vermelho, então. Ou laranja! ...Mas meus lençóis têm um tom lindo de azul-marinho...
The Breaking Point#226.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#227.src: Breakfast... I had some eggs, I suppose. Though, I had no idea that breakfast would be my last, did I..?
The Breaking Point#227.dst: Café da manhã... comi uns ovos, acho. Mas eu nem sabia que seria o último, não é..?
The Breaking Point#227.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#228.src: Hm... Had I known, maybe I would have chosen differently. Maybe I would have-... nevermind.
The Breaking Point#228.dst: Hm... Se soubesse, talvez escolhesse outra coisa. Talvez eu tivesse-... deixa pra lá.
The Breaking Point#228.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#229.src: Regroup at outside {p} at [{~}, {~}, -{~}] to figure out how to free the Elders.
The Breaking Point#229.dst: Reagrupe-se fora de {p} em [{~}, {~}, -{~}] para descobrir como libertar os Anciões.

The Breaking Point#230.src: ... so this is the situation we find ourselves in. Paku, what do you think? Would such a plan work?
The Breaking Point#230.dst: ... então esta é a situação em que nos encontramos. Paku, o que acha? Um plano assim funcionaria?
The Breaking Point#230.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#231.src: ... so that is the situation we find ourselves in. Paku, what do you think? Would such a plan work?
The Breaking Point#231.dst: ... então essa é a situação em que estamos. Paku, o que acha? Um plano assim funcionaria?
The Breaking Point#231.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#232.src: Hm... You may be correct... Draani. The magic in... a dragon's breath... was very potent. And to think... mighty Ozoth had survived... all these years...
The Breaking Point#232.dst: Hm... Talvez tenha razão... Draani. A magia... do sopro de um dragão... era muito potente. E pensar... que a grande Ozoth sobreviveu... tantos anos...
The Breaking Point#232.speaker: Chieftain Paku

The Breaking Point#233.src: If Ozoth is alive... we must seek her help. If the doguns ask... for her aid, she will... give it.
The Breaking Point#233.dst: Se Ozoth vive... devemos buscar sua ajuda. Se os Doguns pedirem... ajuda a ela, ela... a dará.
The Breaking Point#233.speaker: Ineos

The Breaking Point#234.src: Well, that's as good a plan as any. {u}, you'll travel to seek this dragon's counsel, along with... Ineos, was it? Good luck.
The Breaking Point#234.dst: Bem, é um plano tão bom quanto outro. {u}, você vai buscar o conselho dessa dragoa, junto com... Ineos, não é? Boa sorte.
The Breaking Point#234.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#235.src: You should... take the Trading Tunnel... {u}. I will put the coordinates... in your Content Book.
The Breaking Point#235.dst: Pegue... o túnel comercial... {u}. Vou colocar as coordenadas... no seu livro de conteúdo.
The Breaking Point#235.speaker: Ineos

The Breaking Point#236.src: Use the {p} trading tunnel at [{~}, {~}, -{~}] to travel to {p}.
The Breaking Point#236.dst: Use o túnel comercial de {p} em [{~}, {~}, -{~}] para viajar até {p}.

The Breaking Point#237.src: Travel to {p} at [{~}, {~}, -{~}] to attempt to speak with her.
The Breaking Point#237.dst: Viaje até {p} em [{~}, {~}, -{~}] para tentar falar com ela.

The Breaking Point#238.src: Ah... it is... good to... see you. We must... proceed to Ozoth... with all haste.
The Breaking Point#238.dst: Ah... é bom... ver você. Devemos... seguir até Ozoth... com toda a pressa.
The Breaking Point#238.speaker: Ineos

The Breaking Point#239.src: Ozoth the Dragon... Endless Kindler... we have come... to ask for your aid.
The Breaking Point#239.dst: Ozoth, a Dragoa... Acendedora Sem Fim... viemos... pedir sua ajuda.
The Breaking Point#239.speaker: Ineos

The Breaking Point#240.src: We are searching... for a way... to melt the truest... of ice. The fate... of Gavel... hangs in the balance.
The Breaking Point#240.dst: Buscamos... um modo... de derreter o mais puro... dos gelos. O destino... de Gavel... está em jogo.
The Breaking Point#240.speaker: Ineos

The Breaking Point#241.src: Doguns... and Dragons... our fates have been entwined... for centuries. We call on you now... Endless Kindler... to save this province.
The Breaking Point#241.dst: Doguns... e dragões... nossos destinos se entrelaçam... há séculos. Nós a chamamos... Acendedora Sem Fim... para salvar a província.
The Breaking Point#241.speaker: Ineos

The Breaking Point#243.src: The Endless Kindler... is willing to part... with hers. You must... retrieve it... from her stomach.
The Breaking Point#243.dst: A Acendedora Sem Fim... aceita abrir mão... da dela. Você deve... retirá-la... do estômago dela.
The Breaking Point#243.speaker: Ineos

The Breaking Point#244.src: I would advise you... not to think... too much about this. When... you are ready... enter Ozoth's mouth and retrieve... the flame.
The Breaking Point#244.dst: Aconselho você... a não pensar... demais nisso. Quando... estiver pronto... entre na boca de Ozoth e pegue... a chama.
The Breaking Point#244.speaker: Ineos

The Breaking Point#245.src: Descend into Ozoth's belly to retrieve an Everflame.
The Breaking Point#245.dst: Desça até o ventre de Ozoth para obter uma Chama Eterna.

The Breaking Point#246.src: Travel to {p} at [{~}, {~}, -{~}] with an Everflame.
The Breaking Point#246.dst: Viaje até {p} em [{~}, {~}, -{~}] com uma Chama Eterna.

The Breaking Point#247.src: {u}! Have you retrieved... the Eternal Flame?
The Breaking Point#247.speaker: Ineos

The Breaking Point#248.dst: {u}! Você já pegou... a Chama Eterna?
The Breaking Point#248.speaker: Ineos

The Breaking Point#249.src: Excellent. Endless Kindler... thank you... for your sacrifice. I will ensure... that your flame... is returned to you.
The Breaking Point#249.dst: Excelente. Acendedora Sem Fim... obrigado... pelo sacrifício. Garantirei... que sua chama... seja devolvida a você.
The Breaking Point#249.speaker: Ineos

The Breaking Point#250.src: Ozoth apologises... if it was a bit hot... in there.
The Breaking Point#250.dst: Ozoth se desculpa... se estava quente... lá dentro.
The Breaking Point#250.speaker: Ineos

The Breaking Point#251.src: Now, {u}... I was never the best... at the ancient magic... but I hope I have enough skill... to take us the short route back...
The Breaking Point#251.dst: Agora, {u}... nunca fui o melhor... na magia antiga... mas espero ter talento... para nos levar de volta pelo atalho...
The Breaking Point#251.speaker: Ineos

The Breaking Point#252.src: You have returned! Is there news from {p}? Did the dragon offer aid?
The Breaking Point#252.dst: Vocês voltaram! Há notícias de {p}? A dragoa ofereceu ajuda?
The Breaking Point#252.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#253.src: She did... Ozoth has made a great sacrifice... for this province... but we have an Eternal Flame... to melt the ice.
The Breaking Point#253.dst: Ofereceu... Ozoth fez um grande sacrifício... pela província... mas temos uma Chama Eterna... para derreter o gelo.
The Breaking Point#253.speaker: Ineos

The Breaking Point#254.src: She did... Ozoth has made a great sacrifice... for this province... but we have an Everflame... to melt the ice.
The Breaking Point#254.dst: Sim... Ozoth fez um grande sacrifício... por esta província... e temos a Chama Eterna... para derreter o gelo.
The Breaking Point#254.speaker: Ineos

The Breaking Point#255.src: Well done... both of you. I will ensure... that the doguns thank her... properly. The dwarves would do well... to do the same.
The Breaking Point#255.dst: Muito bem... vocês dois. Garantirei... que os Doguns agradeçam a ela... como se deve. Os anões fariam bem... em fazer o mesmo.
The Breaking Point#255.speaker: Chieftain Paku

The Breaking Point#256.src: Yes, yes, but there's no time to worry about that now. Quick, let's get back to the-
The Breaking Point#256.dst: Sim, sim, mas não há tempo para nos preocupar com isso. Rápido, vamos voltar ao-
The Breaking Point#256.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#257.src: Be wary... of the Elders... Draani. It is unlikely they will react well... after their imprisonment. It is vital... you explain the situation... to them.
The Breaking Point#257.dst: Cuidado... com os Anciões... Draani. Dificilmente reagirão bem... após a prisão. É vital... que você explique a situação... a eles.
The Breaking Point#257.speaker: Chieftain Paku

The Breaking Point#258.src: I would join you... both... but the ice is inhospitable... to my kind. I wish the both of you... the best of luck.
The Breaking Point#258.dst: Eu iria com vocês... dois... mas o gelo é inóspito... para minha espécie. Desejo a vocês dois... toda a sorte.
The Breaking Point#258.speaker: Chieftain Paku

The Breaking Point#259.src: ...right. Yes. Well, there's no getting around it. Come, {u}. We must unfreeze the elders and get them to listen to us. Bring the flame, I will meet you at the Vault.
The Breaking Point#259.dst: ...certo. Sim. Bem, não há como evitar. Venha, {u}. Precisamos descongelar os anciões e fazê-los nos ouvir. Traga a chama, encontro você no Cofre.
The Breaking Point#259.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#260.src: ... right. Yes. Well, there's no getting around it. Come, {u}. We must unfreeze the Elders and get them to listen to us. Bring the flame, I will meet you at the Vault.
The Breaking Point#260.dst: ... certo. Sim. Bem, não há como evitar. Venha, {u}. Precisamos descongelar os Anciões e fazê-los nos ouvir. Traga a chama, encontro você no Cofre.
The Breaking Point#260.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#261.src: Return to the Dogun Vault at [{~}, {~}, -{~}] to free the Dogun Elders.
The Breaking Point#261.dst: Volte ao Cofre Dogun em [{~}, {~}, -{~}] para libertar os Anciões Dogun.

The Breaking Point#262.src: Well then, what are we waiting for! Let's free these elders, shall we?
The Breaking Point#262.dst: Bem, o que estamos esperando! Vamos libertar esses anciões, que tal?
The Breaking Point#262.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#263.src: Just bring the Everflame to each of the cells, and melt through that True Ice.
The Breaking Point#263.dst: Basta levar a Chama Eterna a cada cela e derreter aquele True Ice.
The Breaking Point#263.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#264.src: Excellent! We've done it! Now we just need to explain the situation-...
The Breaking Point#264.dst: Excelente! Conseguimos! Agora só precisamos explicar a situação-...
The Breaking Point#264.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#266.src: ...Ah. I suppose I did not... think this through. Ehm. Elders, I must apo-
The Breaking Point#266.dst: ...Ah. Acho que não... pensei bem nisso. Hã. Anciões, devo me descul-
The Breaking Point#266.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#267.src: Dwarf... Hm. The crimes... of your ancestors... must be repaid.
The Breaking Point#267.dst: Anão... Hm. Os crimes... de seus ancestrais... serão pagos.
The Breaking Point#267.speaker: Elder Astal

The Breaking Point#268.src: However. We have... heard you speak. We have... learned of... the Protector's state.
The Breaking Point#268.dst: Porém. Nós... ouvimos você falar. Soubemos... do estado do Protetor.
The Breaking Point#268.speaker: Elder Desint

The Breaking Point#269.src: We will... settle your debt... later. This situation... is a more pressing... concern. The Protector... must be calmed.
The Breaking Point#269.dst: Acertaremos... sua dívida... depois. Esta situação... é mais... urgente. O Protetor... precisa ser acalmado.
The Breaking Point#269.speaker: Elder Iscor

The Breaking Point#270.src: ...Yes. You. Human. That was... dragonfire... was it not?
The Breaking Point#270.dst: ...Sim. Você. Humano. Aquilo era... fogo de dragão... né?
The Breaking Point#270.speaker: Elder Astal

The Breaking Point#271.src: Then allow me... to borrow it. Its strength... will allow us... to restore ours. Now... Who now holds... the title... of Chieftain?
The Breaking Point#271.dst: Então deixe-me... tomá-lo emprestado. Sua força... vai nos ajudar... a restaurar a nossa. Agora... Quem tem... o título de cacique?
The Breaking Point#271.speaker: Elder Astal

The Breaking Point#272.src: A-ah! Paku is now the Dogun Chieftain. He would be at... At Taloka.
The Breaking Point#272.dst: A-ah! Paku agora é o cacique Dogun. Ele deve estar em... Em Taloka.
The Breaking Point#272.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#273.src: Very well... We shall travel... through flame... and through stone...
The Breaking Point#273.dst: Muito bem... Viajaremos... através da chama... e através da pedra...
The Breaking Point#273.speaker: Elder Astal

The Breaking Point#274.src: ...The Elders... after all this time... to see you, again... in the flesh...
The Breaking Point#274.dst: ...Os Anciões... depois de tanto tempo... vê-los de novo... em pessoa...
The Breaking Point#274.speaker: Chieftain Paku

The Breaking Point#275.src: Greetings, Paku. We have much... to discuss. But first... we must travel... to the Protector.
The Breaking Point#275.dst: Saudações, Paku. Temos muito... a discutir. Mas antes... devemos ir... até o Protetor.
The Breaking Point#275.speaker: Elder Desint

The Breaking Point#276.src: Join us... Ineos and Paku. There is... very little time... to waste.
The Breaking Point#276.dst: Venham... Ineos e Paku. Há... muito pouco tempo... a perder.
The Breaking Point#276.speaker: Elder Astal

The Breaking Point#277.src: Now, let us travel... Through flame... and through stone...
The Breaking Point#277.dst: Agora, vamos... Através da chama... e através da pedra...
The Breaking Point#277.speaker: Elder Astal

The Breaking Point#278.src: Korzim... my son... join us. The Elders must see... to the Protector.
The Breaking Point#278.dst: Korzim... meu filho... venha. Os Anciões precisam ver... o Protetor.
The Breaking Point#278.speaker: Chieftain Paku

The Breaking Point#279.src: Iscor... Astal... Desint... it has been... too long. I will come.
The Breaking Point#279.dst: Iscor... Astal... Desint... faz... tempo demais. Eu irei.
The Breaking Point#279.speaker: Korzim

The Breaking Point#280.src: earth and flame... fire and stone... transport us through your form!
The Breaking Point#280.dst: terra e chama... fogo e pedra... levem-nos através de sua forma!
The Breaking Point#280.speaker: Elder Astal

The Breaking Point#282.src: There's no time! I can feel the damned ground cracking beneath my feet, we have to turn to the final option. We've had demolition mages on standby the past few days, our only choice is to-
The Breaking Point#282.dst: Não há tempo! Sinto o maldito chão rachando sob meus pés, temos que partir para a última opção. Temos magos de demolição de prontidão há dias, nossa única escolha é-
The Breaking Point#282.speaker: General Elix

The Breaking Point#283.src: Rhay. Elix. My Elders... have been freed. They are here... to help... the Protector.
The Breaking Point#283.dst: Rhay. Elix. Meus Anciões... estão livres. Estão aqui... para ajudar... o Protetor.
The Breaking Point#283.speaker: Ineos

The Breaking Point#284.src: Join us... brave ones. You will see... that your efforts to save this Province... have not been in vain.
The Breaking Point#284.dst: Venham... bravos. Vocês verão... que seu esforço para salvar esta Província... não foi em vão.
The Breaking Point#284.speaker: Elder Iscor

The Breaking Point#285.src: flames of the earth... take us to the great protector... to make our plea!
The Breaking Point#285.dst: chamas da terra... levem-nos ao grande protetor... para nosso apelo!
The Breaking Point#285.speaker: Elder Astal

The Breaking Point#286.src: Travel to the Canyon Colossus at [{~}, {~}, -{~}] to attempt to calm it.
The Breaking Point#286.dst: Viaje até o Colosso do Cânion em [{~}, {~}, -{~}] para tentar acalmá-lo.

The Breaking Point#288.src: Hmph. Foolish dwarves... This is what has come...of your needless war... You are fortunate...to have freed us now...
The Breaking Point#288.dst: Hmpf. Anões tolos... Eis no que deu...sua guerra inútil... Vocês têm sorte...de nos libertar agora...
The Breaking Point#288.speaker: Elder Astal

The Breaking Point#289.src: Desint... Iscor... I will prepare... the ritual. Defend me... as I do so.
The Breaking Point#289.dst: Desint... Iscor... Prepararei... o ritual. Defendam-me... enquanto isso.
The Breaking Point#289.speaker: Elder Astal

The Breaking Point#290.src: Human. We will pull the Protector... away from the brink. That is all we can do now. All the power... we can muster.
The Breaking Point#290.dst: Humano. Vamos afastar o Protetor... do abismo. É tudo o que podemos fazer agora. Todo o poder... que conseguirmos.
The Breaking Point#290.speaker: Elder Desint

The Breaking Point#291.src: You must enter... these sacred grounds. Battle through to the end... Knock some sense... into it.
The Breaking Point#291.dst: Você deve entrar... nestas terras sagradas. Lute até o fim... Faça-o... cair em si.
The Breaking Point#291.speaker: Elder Iscor

The Breaking Point#292.src: Adventurer... We are counting...on you. We will try to...support you however we can.
The Breaking Point#292.dst: Aventureiro... Contamos...com você. Tentaremos...apoiar você como pudermos.
The Breaking Point#292.speaker: Ineos

The Breaking Point#293.src: We'll do the best we can out here! I have some ideas already...
The Breaking Point#293.dst: Faremos o possível aqui fora! Já tenho algumas ideias...
The Breaking Point#293.speaker: Rhay

The Breaking Point#294.src: Rhay, this isn't the time. Human. We have your back. You can do this.
The Breaking Point#294.dst: Rhay, não é hora. Humano. Estamos com você. Você consegue.
The Breaking Point#294.speaker: General Elix

The Breaking Point#295.src: You have faced...worse odds before...have you not? You will face them...again.
The Breaking Point#295.dst: Você já enfrentou...situações piores...não é? E vai enfrentá-las...de novo.
The Breaking Point#295.speaker: Korzim

The Breaking Point#296.src: It is done. Desint... Iscor... Take your positions. We must... hold it back.
The Breaking Point#296.dst: Está feito. Desint... Iscor... Às suas posições. Devemos... contê-lo.
The Breaking Point#296.speaker: Elder Astal

The Breaking Point#297.src: great protector, lord of stone, hear our burning call. your fury clouds your vision, your anger burns and twists our home.
The Breaking Point#297.dst: grande protetor, senhor da pedra, ouça nosso chamado ardente. sua fúria o cega, sua ira queima e distorce nosso lar.
The Breaking Point#297.speaker: Elder Astal

The Breaking Point#298.src: we, the doguns, who now hold the final flame of a fallen god... we will hold you back. we will keep this land intact!
The Breaking Point#298.dst: nós, os doguns, que agora guardamos a última chama de um deus caído... vamos contê-lo. manteremos esta terra intacta!
The Breaking Point#298.speaker: Elder Astal

The Breaking Point#299.src: We will... hold it from here... human. Now... go! We will not... be able to hold it... for long...
The Breaking Point#299.dst: Vamos... segurá-lo daqui... humano. Agora... vá! Não poderemos... contê-lo... por muito tempo...
The Breaking Point#299.speaker: Elder Astal

The Breaking Point#300.src: This crystal...will let you harness...our flame. Use it...to break through...its defenses.
The Breaking Point#300.dst: Este cristal...permite que você use...nossa chama. Use-o...para romper...as defesas dele.
The Breaking Point#300.speaker: Elder Astal

The Breaking Point#301.src: {u}... Before you go. I will offer you... these powerful relics. Our people... have held them for... longer than I have lived. They may... help you on your quest.
The Breaking Point#301.dst: {u}... Antes de ir. Ofereço a você... estas poderosas relíquias. Meu povo... as guarda há... mais tempo do que vivi. Talvez... ajudem em sua missão.
The Breaking Point#301.speaker: Chieftain Paku

The Breaking Point#302.src: I cannot give you something as unique as what Paku has offered, but I can still lend you a sum from our treasury. Use it as you must, so long as you can calm that thing. Good luck.
The Breaking Point#302.dst: Não posso dar algo tão único quanto o que Paku ofereceu, mas posso emprestar uma quantia do nosso tesouro. Use como precisar, desde que acalme aquela coisa. Boa sorte.
The Breaking Point#302.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#304.src: Have you flown to Corkus with Rhay yet? Quick, get to the Hot Air Balloon in the south!
The Breaking Point#304.dst: Já voou para Corkus com Rhay? Rápido, vá até o balão de ar quente no sul!
The Breaking Point#304.speaker: General Elix

The Breaking Point#305.src: Just step on the iron platform and we'll send you down!
The Breaking Point#305.dst: É só subir na plataforma de ferro que a gente te desce!
The Breaking Point#305.speaker: Rhay

The Breaking Point#306.src: [!] Central bore tunnel opening! Exercise caution around the deep drop.
The Breaking Point#306.dst: [!] Abrindo o túnel de perfuração central! Cuidado com a queda funda.

The Breaking Point#307.src: You got the part! Head back to the balloon and I'll meet you there.
The Breaking Point#307.dst: Você pegou a peça! Volte ao balão que encontro você lá.
The Breaking Point#307.speaker: Maxie

The Breaking Point#308.src: Have you flown to the Heights with Ineos yet? Quick, get to the Hot Air Balloon in the south!
The Breaking Point#308.dst: Já voou para as Heights com Ineos? Rápido, vá até o balão de ar quente no sul!
The Breaking Point#308.speaker: General Elix

The Breaking Point#309.src: I... will meet you... by the airship. I am... eager... to see my home... again.
The Breaking Point#309.dst: Encontro você... junto à aeronave. Quero muito... ver meu lar... de novo.
The Breaking Point#309.speaker: General Elix

The Breaking Point#310.src: Well... That's it, then! I'll see you two off, and then... Then I'll figure out how to clean up here.
The Breaking Point#310.dst: Bem... Então é isso! Vou me despedir de vocês dois e depois... Depois vejo como limpar tudo isto.
The Breaking Point#310.speaker: Rhay

The Breaking Point#311.src: I... I really did hope we could do it. I thought that our magic could save the day, that it could stop this thing!
The Breaking Point#311.dst: Eu... eu realmente esperava que conseguíssemos. Achei que nossa magia salvaria o dia, que pararia essa coisa!
The Breaking Point#311.speaker: Rhay

The Breaking Point#312.src: ... Nothing to do about it now, of course! Good luck out there. We're counting on you two now. Go find those Elders!
The Breaking Point#312.dst: ... Não há mais o que fazer, claro! Boa sorte lá fora. Agora contamos com vocês dois. Vão encontrar aqueles Anciões!
The Breaking Point#312.speaker: Rhay

The Breaking Point#313.src: It has been... many years... since I fled the Heights. I am... grateful to... the Corkians... for taking me in.
The Breaking Point#313.dst: Faz... muitos anos... que fugi das Heights. Sou... grato... aos Corkians... por me acolherem.
The Breaking Point#313.speaker: Ineos

The Breaking Point#314.src: But... The war... has ended. I can finally... go home...
The Breaking Point#314.dst: E... A guerra... acabou. Enfim posso... ir para casa...
The Breaking Point#314.speaker: Ineos

The Breaking Point#315.src: ... {p} first... though. We still... have work to do...
The Breaking Point#315.dst: ... Mas antes... {p}. Ainda temos... o que fazer...
The Breaking Point#315.speaker: Ineos

The Breaking Point#316.src: What are you waiting for? Use my hook to get to the override switch at the end of this cave!
The Breaking Point#316.dst: O que está esperando? Use meu gancho para chegar ao interruptor manual no fim desta caverna!
The Breaking Point#316.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#317.src: Come, {u}. We must unfreeze the Elders and get them to listen to us. Bring the flame, I will meet you at the Vault.
The Breaking Point#317.dst: Venha, {u}. Precisamos descongelar os Anciões e fazê-los nos ouvir. Traga a chama, encontro você no Cofre.
The Breaking Point#317.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#318.src: Well? What are you waiting for- come on, let's get going to Corkus!
The Breaking Point#318.dst: E então? O que está esperando- vamos, rumo a Corkus!
The Breaking Point#318.speaker: Rhay

The Breaking Point#319.src: Well, what are you waiting for?! Put the part in the machine, quick!
The Breaking Point#319.dst: E então, o que está esperando?! Coloque a peça na máquina, rápido!
The Breaking Point#319.speaker: General Elix

The Breaking Point#320.src: Good luck in the heights, {u}. I'll... see if there's anything I can salvage from the machine, but it's not looking good. Ineos' Elders might be our only hope...
The Breaking Point#320.dst: Boa sorte nas Heights, {u}. Vou... ver se dá para salvar algo da máquina, mas não parece bom. Os Anciões de Ineos podem ser nossa única esperança...
The Breaking Point#320.speaker: Rhay

The Breaking Point#321.src: You should... take the Trading Tunnel... {u}. I have put the coordinates... in your Content Book.
The Breaking Point#321.dst: Pegue... o túnel comercial... {u}. Coloquei as coordenadas... no seu livro de conteúdo.
The Breaking Point#321.speaker: Ineos
